label: Getting started
description: Install Myne, create your first encrypted vault, save your recovery phrase, and write your first note.

label: Notes & organization
description: Organize your vault with folders and folder notes, favorites, trash and archive, multi-select actions, tabs, split view and named workspaces, templates, daily notes, drawings, and tasks.

label: Editor & writing
description: Write in the editor with view modes, focus mode, folding, multiple cursors, find and replace, slash commands, the selection toolbar, comments, spell check, display settings, note covers, saved views, and note export.

label: Markdown
description: The markdown Myne renders, from basics and tables to code blocks, embeds, math, diagrams, callouts, and frontmatter.

label: Find & connect
description: Locate and relate notes with wikilinks, backlinks, unlinked mentions, tags, search, and the graph view.

label: Attachments & import
description: Attach files and record voice notes, manage them in the attachments library, and import an existing Obsidian vault.

label: AI (Beta)
description: Turn on Myne's experimental AI, choose where it runs — a model file on your computer, a runtime you already have, or a remote provider you name — then ask questions across your notes with citations, summarize notes, suggest tags, get inline writing help, and read the honest privacy boundary.

label: Sync & devices
description: Keep your encrypted notes in step across the devices you own. Set up a hosted or self-hosted server, check its certificate fingerprint, add and approve devices with your account number, read sync status, and resolve conflicts, all zero-knowledge, with no email.

label: Safety & recovery
description: Recover a forgotten password, tell a real recovery-phrase prompt from a fake one, back up and restore your vault, upgrade its storage format, use note snapshots, and manage multiple vaults.

label: Settings & privacy
description: Adjust appearance and keyboard shortcuts, set up quick unlock and auto-lock, protect against screen capture, choose whether vault names appear on the lock screen, change your password, reach the settings behind Developer mode, and understand the privacy model.

label: Command line
description: Read, search, and add notes from a terminal with the myne command-line client, which drives the running, unlocked app over a local socket.
